dataset.name: competition-parquet-row
dataset.official_metric_note: This is row/time-level target evaluation on y_*.parquet rows; held-out validation should be grouped by id.
dataset.reduced_test_policy: Reduced labeled test parquet files are read only when split='reduced_test' is explicitly requested.
dataset.split_policy: Use grouped split manifests keyed by sample_id; rows from one id must stay in one split.

ensembles.selection_policy: validation-only OOF archive selection; internal test is reported after selection and is not used for choosing members
